THE_RULE: A COMBINED DAY RECORD LACKING ANY FIELD BELOW IS **EVIDENCE, NOT A RESULT**. It may be read, cited as provenance and kept; it may NOT be quoted as the day's outcome, pooled, or carried into a verdict. The distinction is the point: an incomplete record is not worthless, it is a DIFFERENT KIND OF THING, and calling it a result is the error this rule exists to prevent.

FUTILITY_VERIFIED_INDEPENDENTLY_BY_DA.method: recomputed best_attainable_p from the recorded n_negative and days_declared as a TWO-SIDED BINOMIAL SIGN TEST -- 2 * P(X >= days_declared - n_negative | n = days_declared, p = 0.5) -- not read from the field

CONDVALUE_X_SKEW.derivation: two-sided binomial sign test: 2 * P(X >= 5 | n=7, p=0.5) with the 2 already-negative day(s) unrecoverable

HAZARD_OVER_SKEWED_REF.derivation: two-sided binomial sign test: 2 * P(X >= 6 | n=7, p=0.5) with the 1 already-negative day(s) unrecoverable

FUTILITY_VERIFIED_INDEPENDENTLY_BY_DA.WHAT_IT_MEANS: BOTH ARMS ARE FUTILE AT G=7 AFTER TWO SCORED DAYS. Even if every one of the five remaining days went the right way, CONDVALUE_X_SKEW could reach at best p = 0.453125 and HAZARD_OVER_SKEWED_REF at best p = 0.125, against a threshold of 0.025. The floor with all seven unanimous is 0.015625, which WOULD clear -- so the arms are not killed by the design, they are killed by the two negative days already observed.
FUTILITY_VERIFIED_INDEPENDENTLY_BY_DA.NO_VERDICT_IS_ASSERTED_HERE: this records the COMPUTED futility the record carries and DA's confirmation of its arithmetic. Whether the programme stops is the coordinator's ruling.

NAMING_RULE_FOR_REPRODUCTION_RECORDS.RULE: a reproduction record is named `p003_de_reproduction_*`. It is NEVER named `p003_de_forward_value_*`.
NAMING_RULE_FOR_REPRODUCTION_RECORDS.why: `p003_de_forward_value_*.json` is the DAY-RESULT GLOB. A reproduction named into that glob is counted as a day until something filters it out, and a filter is a thing that can be wrong. Naming it outside the glob makes the mistake unrepresentable rather than merely caught.

RESIDUE_TWO_MIS_NAMED_REPRODUCTION_RECOR.KEPT_NOT_DELETED: artifacts are never deleted; these are provenance of how the naming rule came to exist.

EXCLUDED_FROM_EVERY_COUNT_BY.mechanism: de_day_record's day map -- `if d.get("reproduction") or d.get("protocol","").endswith("_REPRODUCTION"): continue`
EXCLUDED_FROM_EVERY_COUNT_BY.THE_REASON_IT_WORKS_IS_WORTH_STATING: *** THE TWO RESIDUES CARRY `protocol: P003_DE_DAY_RECORD_V1` -- THE SAME PROTOCOL AS A REAL DAY RESULT, NOT THE `_REPRODUCTION` ONE. *** So the protocol half of that test does NOT catch them. They are excluded by the FIRST clause -- the presence of a `reproduction` BLOCK -- which is identity, not vocabulary and not the filename. Had the filter keyed on protocol alone it would have counted both as days.
